complexity.notes: M = max(piles) is value-dependent, not size-dependent, so log M does not scale with n (and is capped at ~30 under the statement's constraints). The left debug print(start, end) should be removed. The list comprehension inside sum() builds an O(n) intermediate list; a generator expression sum(math.ceil(p/k) for p in piles) would make space O(1). The k == 0 guard is unnecessary if the search starts at 1.
complexity.summary: Binary search over the eating rate k in [0, max(piles)+1], testing feasibility by summing ceil(pile/k) hours over all piles and narrowing toward the minimum feasible k.
